initial:
Create a production 24-FRAME SPRITE SHEET animation asset by extracting and animating the sleeping calico cat in reference 1. Reference 1 is the authoritative cat and watercolor appearance; reference 2 is a supporting isolated view only. Preserve the cat's round face, closed happy eyes, short nose, orange left face patch, charcoal right crown/ear, white cheeks and tucked front paws, fluffy curled torso extending to the left. Do NOT redesign the character. This must be actual separately drawn animation poses, NOT 24 copies of a still image and NOT global scaling, translation, rotation or rubber warping.

OUTPUT EXACTLY 24 COMPLETE CAT SPRITES on a true transparent RGBA background in a perfectly regular SIX COLUMNS by FOUR ROWS atlas. Canvas 3072 by 2048 pixels; each cell 512 by 512. Read frames left-to-right, top-to-bottom. No text, labels, grid lines, numbers, floor, mat, scenery, cast shadow, borders or checkerboard. Equal transparent padding, same camera, identical body scale, same face location and paw contact line in EVERY cell. Within each 512x512 cell cat including moving tail fits x24..488,y90..430, front paws always baseline y430. Do not crop any ear/tail. Body remains reclining and relaxed, face/torso stay registered, only ear articulation and tail gesture visibly change. Draw consistent watercolor fur markings frame to frame.

Animation plan, loop: frames 1-6 right ear slowly rotates outward 0,8,16,24,32,36 degrees with a slight tip fold, left ear follows slightly, cat remains comfortably asleep. Frames 7-12 right ear returns smoothly through 30,24,18,12,6,0 degrees; simultaneously the visible curled tail at the LEFT of the body begins lifting at the tip. Frames 13-18 tail tip lifts clearly into a lazy little curve, moving from low resting curl to a curved raised tip about 60px above its resting position then sweeping gently left; both ears relaxed. Frames 19-24 tail returns smoothly to the original curled resting shape, endpoint closely matches frame1 for a seamless loop. Each pose is a distinct meaningful drawing. Tail anatomical continuity: tail connects to LEFT rump, not a new tail growing out of the face or paws. Keep tail safely inside its own cell. Full original cat visible in all24 cells. This is for a calm Japanese handpainted Godot2D game, not pixel art, not 3D. Transparent background required.
